name: "💡 Idea or feature"
about: "Got an idea that could make this project more useful? Share it!"
title: "[Idea]: "
labels: enhancement

---

## What's the idea?

Tell us what you'd like to see. Rough ideas are totally fine.

## What would it help with?

What problem would this solve, or what could become easier?

## Who might find it useful?

For example: students, job seekers, or people trying to stay focused.

## Any thoughts on how it could work? (optional)

Share a sketch, example, or possible approach if you have one. It's okay if you don't know the technical details yet.

## Want to work on it together?

Let us know if you'd like to discuss it, test it, design it, or try building it with others.
